verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents official client-side SDKs: a WebSDK with access-token initialization and a React package, plus Mobile SDKs including an iOS theme API. These are verification-UI SDKs, and the evidence shows no official server-side client libraries for its REST API, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented backend/server SDK libraries wrapping the REST API, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients, documented language and platform coverage beyond Web/React/iOS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.
